description: Real published Rotax 915 iS A/C24 performance and limits data, extracted from the official BRP-Rotax Operator's Manual. Intended as [ROTAX]-tagged Phase A anchor data. The full RPM/MAP power+BSFC lookup table is NOT published in the operator's manual PDF -- BRP-Rotax only distributes it as a proprietary interactive 'Performance and Fuel Consumption Model' tool on flyrotax.com/service/technical-documentation.html, which is not scrapable/downloadable as a static table. The values below are the real numeric anchor points and operating limits that ARE published in the manual text.

source.document: OPERATORS MANUAL FOR ROTAX ENGINE TYPE 915 i A / C24 SERIES
source.note: Fetched directly (curl); WebFetch tool was blocked with HTTP 403 on this host, so content was pulled as raw PDF bytes and parsed with pypdf.

geometry.configuration: 4-stroke, 4-cylinder flat, turbocharged, intercooled, liquid-cooled heads, ram-air cooled cylinders

power_anchors_ROTAX.description: The only two numeric (RPM, power) pairs actually published in the manual text. Real data, not fabricated -- but only 2 points, not a full curve.

temperature_c.note: condensation risk if run below 90-110C; reach 100C at least once/day

usage_notes: These anchor points can be used to sanity-check / lightly re-anchor the Phase A gas-path fit (steady-state P_brake at 5500rpm/1450mbar should be ~99kW, at 5800rpm/1520mbar should be ~104kW) but cannot replace a real bicubic eta_vol(N,p_im) and eta_ind_0(lambda,N,p_im) surface fit -- that requires the proprietary Rotax Performance and Fuel Consumption Model, which was not accessible.

Oil pressure, oil temperature, coolant temperature, and EGT limits above are real physical bounds and should replace any [ASSUMED] placeholder limits used for RUL failure-threshold computation (02_physics_twin_residuals.md L6 theta_j^fail solver) and for TelemetryFrame validity bounds.
